title: CPF Module Schema: CosmosDB Mongo Database module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-cosmosdbmongodatabase'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

autoscale_settings.description: (Optional) object({ max_throughput = (Optional) The maximum throughput of the MongoDB database (RU/s). Must be between 1,000 and 1,000,000. Must be set in increments of 1,000. Conflicts with throughput. })

cosmosdb_account_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Cosmos DB Account. Used as parent resource for MongoDB role definitions.

cosmosdb_account_name.description: (Required) The name of the Cosmos DB Mongo Database to create the table within. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

inherited_role_names.description: (Optional) A list of Mongo Roles that are inherited to the Mongo User Definition.

mongo_role_definition.type: object({ role_name = string type = optional(string, "CustomRole") inherited_role_names = optional(list(string)) privileges = optional(list(object({ actions = list(string) resource = object({ collection_name = optional(string) db_name = optional(string) }) }))) })
mongo_role_definition.description: (Optional) Configuration for MongoDB Role Definition. object({ role_name = (Required) A user-friendly name for the Role Definition. Must be unique for the database account. type = (Optional) Indicates whether the Role Definition was built-in or user created. Possible values are 'CustomRole' and 'BuiltInRole'. Defaults to 'CustomRole'. inherited_role_names = (Optional) A list of role names which are inherited by this Role Definition. privileges = (Optional) A list of privilege objects. Each privilege contains: - actions = (Required) An array of actions that are allowed. - resource = (Required) A resource block containing: - collection_name = (Optional) The collection name the role is applied. - db_name = (Optional) The database name the role is applied. })

mongocollection.type: map(object({ name = string shard_key = optional(string) analytical_storage_ttl = optional(number, -1) default_ttl_seconds = optional(number, -1) throughput = optional(number) index = optional(map(object({ keys = list(string) unique = optional(bool, false) }))) autoscale_settings = optional(object({ max_throughput = optional(number, 1000) })) }))
mongocollection.description: (Optional) map(object({ name = (Required) Specifies the name of the Cosmos DB Mongo Collection. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. shard_key = (Optional) The name of the key to partition on for sharding. There must not be any other unique index keys. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. analytical_storage_ttl = (Optional) The default time to live of Analytical Storage for this Mongo Collection. If present and the value is set to -1, it is equal to infinity, and items don’t expire by default. If present and the value is set to some number n – items will expire n seconds after their last modified time. default_ttl_seconds = (Optional) The default Time To Live in seconds. If the value is -1, items are not automatically expired. throughput = (Optional) The throughput of the MongoDB collection (RU/s). Must be set in increments of 100. The minimum value is 400. This must be set upon database creation otherwise it cannot be updated without a manual terraform destroy-apply. index = (Optional) One or more index blocks as defined below. (map(object({ keys = (Required) Specifies the list of user settable keys for each Cosmos DB Mongo Collection. unique = (Optional) Is the index unique or not? Defaults to false. }))) autoscale_settings = (Optional) An autoscale_settings block as defined below. This must be set upon database creation otherwise it cannot be updated without a manual terraform destroy-apply. (object({ max_throughput = (Optional) The maximum throughput of the MongoDB collection (RU/s). Must be between 1,000 and 1,000,000. Must be set in increments of 1,000. Conflicts with throughput. })) }))

mongodatabase_name.description: (Required) Specifies the name of the Cosmos DB Mongo Database. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

mongodb_password.description: (Required) The password for the Mongo User Definition.

mongodb_username.description: (Required) The username for the Mongo User Definition. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

throughput.description: (Optional) The throughput of the MongoDB database (RU/s). Must be set in increments of 100. The minimum value is 400 and has a maximum value of 1000000. This must be set upon database creation otherwise it cannot be updated without a manual terraform destroy-apply.

id.description: The ID of the Cosmos DB Mongo Database.

mongo_collection_id.description: The ID of the Cosmos DB Mongo Collection.

mongo_collection_name.description: The Name of the Cosmos DB Mongo Collection.

mongo_collection_resource.description: The resource of the Cosmos DB Mongo Collection.

name.description: The Name of the Cosmos DB Mongo Database.

resource.description: The Cosmos DB Mongo Database resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Cosmosdbmongodatabase' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
